newsitem.title: USA: Choices Entertainment to sell off assets.
newsitem.headline: Choices Entertainment to sell off assets.

text.p: Choices Entertainment Corp said on Monday that it agreed to sell substantially all its assets to West Coast Entertainment Corp for about $2.4 million in cash.
Choices said the price may be reduced, depending on its cash flow from operations for 1996.
The company also said its shareholders would elect a new board of directors on December 20. It said all decisions regarding its future direction will be made by the new board.
